tasks.title: Lecture #5
tasks.instruction: Listen to part of a lecture in a college music class.
tasks.transcript: OK…That about does it for today. We’re going to spend the next few classes on a different kind of music. We’ll examine the development of jazz from its beginnings right on up to the latest in jazz music. We’ll look at jazz as the most successful music indigenous to the United States…born in New Orleans and raised in Chicago and New York. We’ll begin with the African roots of the music and how African rhythms blended with Western music to create an entirely new form. Then we’ll follow jazz into its heyday – the 1920’s, which was known as the Jazz Age. It was in this era that the blues were born. The 1930’s saw the evolution of “swing,” jazz music played by the big bands like that of Tommy Dorsey. If there’s any generalization that can made about jazz, it’s that the music is always changing…evolving…from the Bebop of the ‘40’s to the “cool jazz” of the ‘50’s and on into the experimental ‘60’s. The ‘70’s saw jazz brought into the electronic age by artists like Herbie Hancock. We’ll end up listening to some examples of the newest transformation of jazz…Afro-pop and the Latin beats that’ve brought new international flair to this music born in the United States. Be sure to read chapters 13 and 14 of your text. They’ll get you started. If there are any jazz devotees among you, feel free to bring in your favorite tapes or CD’s to share with the class. Renee Rosnes’ latest release would be great if anyone has it.

questions.stem: What is the speaker’s main purpose?

options.A: To explain what he’s going to talk about today.
options.B: To summarize the lecture he just gave.
options.C: To let students know what they’ll be studying soon.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：演讲者的主要目的是什么？ 定位原文：OK…That about does it for today. We're going to spend the next few classes on a different kind of music. We'll examine the development of jazz from its beginnings right on up to the latest in jazz music. 选项分析： A. To explain what he's going to talk about today.（解释今天要讲的内容。）。由于演讲者说"今天就到这里"，说明今天的课已经结束，他是在介绍未来几节课的内容，所以A选项错误。 B. To summarize the lecture he just gave.（总结刚刚讲的课程。）。因为演讲者没有总结今天的内容，而是预告接下来的课程安排，所以B选项错误。 C. To let students know what they'll be studying soon.（让学生了解他们即将学习的内容。）。基于演讲者明确说明接下来几节课将研究爵士乐的发展，因此C选项正确。 D. To suggest extra readings.（推荐阅读额外材料。）。虽然提到了阅读课本章节，但这只是演讲内容的一部分，并非主要目的，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will probably be the subject of the next lecture?

options.D: The development of jazz recording companies.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：下一堂课的主题可能是什么？ 定位原文：We'll begin with the African roots of the music and how African rhythms blended with Western music to create an entirely new form. 选项分析： A. The origins of jazz.（爵士乐的起源。）。由于演讲者说将从非洲根源开始讲起，探讨非洲节奏如何与西方音乐融合，这正是爵士乐的起源，所以A选项正确。 B. The instruments used in jazz.（爵士乐使用的乐器。）。因为演讲中没有提及乐器相关内容，所以B选项错误。 C. The newest transformation of jazz.（爵士乐的最新转变。）。基于演讲者提到最新的转变是放在课程结尾讨论，而非下一堂课，所以C选项错误。 D. The development of jazz recording companies.（爵士乐唱片公司的发展。）。由于演讲内容完全未涉及唱片公司，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What are some students asked to bring to class?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：一些学生被要求带什么来课堂？ 定位原文：If there are any jazz devotees among you, feel free to bring in your favorite tapes or CD's to share with the class. 选项分析： A. Their textbooks.（他们的课本。）。虽然提到了阅读课本章节，但没有要求带课本到课堂，所以A选项错误。 B. Jazz recordings.（爵士乐录音。）。由于演讲者邀请爵士乐爱好者带喜欢的磁带或CD来与全班分享，因此B选项正确。 C. Friends who are musicians.（音乐家朋友。）。因为没有提及邀请朋友来课堂，所以C选项错误。 D. Musical instruments.（乐器。）。基于演讲内容未涉及带乐器的要求，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker emphasize about jazz music?

options.A: It is no longer a popular form of music.
options.B: It has only a small group of devoted fans.
options.C: It has undergone many changes over the years.
options.D: It is a Latin American music form.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：演讲者强调了爵士乐的什么特点？ 定位原文：If there's any generalization that can be made about jazz, it's that the music is always changing…evolving…from the Bebop of the '40's to the "cool jazz" of the '50's and on into the experimental '60's. 选项分析： A. It is no longer a popular form of music.（它不再是一种流行的音乐形式。）。由于演讲者没有表达爵士乐不再流行的观点，所以A选项错误。 B. It has only a small group of devoted fans.（它只有一小群忠实粉丝。）。因为演讲中没有提到粉丝数量少的内容，所以B选项错误。 C. It has undergone many changes over the years.（它多年来经历了许多变化。）。基于演讲者明确指出如果要对爵士乐做一个概括，那就是这种音乐总是在变化和演变，并列举了从40年代Bebop到50年代冷爵士再到60年代实验爵士的发展历程，因此C选项正确。 D. It is a Latin American music form.（它是一种拉丁美洲音乐形式。）。由于演讲者说爵士乐是美国本土最成功的音乐，诞生于新奥尔良，所以D选项错误。
